listing.name: Doom / DSDA-Doom
listing.summary: Play Doom or Freedoom in DSDA-Doom, a source port with tools for recording and replaying speedruns.

steps.title: Choose your game data
steps.instruction: Use the IWAD from your own Doom installation or a freely available Freedoom IWAD. Pass -iwad followed by the path to that file. Keep the supplied dsda-doom.wad with the engine. It supplies engine resources. Heretic and Hexen require their own IWADs and follow the upstream setup instructions.

steps.title: Start DSDA-Doom on Windows
steps.instruction: Extract the complete publisher x64 ZIP. From that directory, run dsda-doom.exe with your IWAD.

steps.title: Start DSDA-Doom on Linux
steps.instruction: Use your distribution’s dsda-doom package if available. If you already have the publisher’s x86-64 AppImage, make it executable and run it with your IWAD. Without FUSE, extract it with --appimage-extract and run AppRun from the complete extracted directory. Install your distribution’s JACK client library if the player reports libjack.so.0 missing.

steps.title: Start DSDA-Doom on a Mac
steps.instruction: The publisher’s v0.30.1 universal ZIP has a Terminal executable for Intel and Apple Silicon. Both slices require macOS 26 or later. Keep dsda-doom and dsda-doom.wad together and run ./dsda-doom with your IWAD. Homebrew also packages DSDA-Doom for Apple Silicon and Linux, including Linux ARM64.

warnings: The package manager or your external installation owns updates. The player owns its save and settings files.

references.title: Keep the profile and matching runtime
references.instruction: On Linux preserve $XDG_DATA_HOME/dsda-doom, normally ~/.local/share/dsda-doom. It holds dsda-doom.cfg and per-IWAD saves and statistics in dsda_doom_data. Keep the engine version, IWAD and any add-ons used by a save or demo when changing packages.

listing.download_block_reason: The publisher archives bundle a soundfont and game sounds whose redistribution terms need verification. Use a distribution package or the upstream project for an external copy.

original_game_review.reason: The authored source/setup scope explicitly permits Doom or Freedoom originals, with per-IWAD game/save choices. This broad engine record is not scoped to one original game.
